TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026 has been released by Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission on 17 July on the official website @tnpscresults.tn.gov.in for Combined Civil Services Examination I (Group – I Services) conducted under Notification No. 04/2025. The result PDF includes the number of candidates selected for appointment through Direct recruitment to various Group 1 posts. TNPSC Group 1 Final Result 2026 Out

TNPSC Group 1 Final Result is now available on the official website. Candidates who appeared for the examination can download the result PDF online. The result has been published in PDF format and includes the number of qualified candidates. Candidates should carefully check result and keep a copy of the result for future reference.

TNPSC Group 1 2025-26 Overview

TNPSC Group 1 2026 Result has been declared for the Combined Civil Services Exam under Notification No. 04/2025. Candidates can check the result online by downloading the official result PDF. The table below provides an important details related to result.

Particulars Details
Exam Name Combined Civil Services Examination-I (Group-I Services)
Conducting Body Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission (TNPSC)
Notification Number 04/2025
Main Examination 1 to 4 December 2025
Interview Dates 15 & 16 April 2026
Counselling Date 16 June 2026
TNPSC Group 1 Result Date 17 July 2026
Result Status Released
Official Website tnpscresults.tn.gov.in

TNPSC Group 1 Result Download PDF

TNPSC Group 1 Result PDF is available on the official website. Candidates can download the PDF and check roll numbers to know qualifying status. The result is published in PDF format and does not require any login credentials. It is advisable to save a copy of the result PDF for future reference. Candidates can download the result PDF from below

Download TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026 PDF

How to Check the TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026?

Candidates who appeared for the TNPSC Group 1 exam can check their result online through the official portal. Candidates can follow the instructions below to access and download the result.

  • Visit the official website @tnpscresults.tn.gov.in
  • Click on the TNPSC Group 1 Final Result 2026 link on the homepage.
  • Enter roll number or registration ID.
  • Click on the submit button.
  • The TNSPC Group 1 merit list will be displayed on the screen.
  • Download the PDF and save it for future reference.

TNPSC Group 1 Cut Off PDF: Click to Download

Details Mentioned on TNPSC Group 1 Rank List 2026

The TNPSC Group 1 Result PDF contains important information about the candidate’s performance in the examination. Candidates should carefully verify all the details. In case of discrepancy the candidate should immediately report to the authorities for correction. The details mentioned in the result are as follows.

  • Notification Number
  • Roll number/ Registration ID
  • Name of the Post Applied
  • Qualifying Status

What’s Next After TNPSC Group 1 Final Result 2026?

With TNPSC Group 1 Final Result 2026 now declared, the recruitment process has reached its final stage. Candidates whose roll numbers are included in the result will proceed with the appointment formalities as notified by Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission. Candidates will be required to complete document verification and other joining formalities. After completing this candidates will be appointed for respective Group 1 Posts.

TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026 FAQs

Q1. Is TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026 released?

Ans: The final result released on 17 July 2026.

Q2. Where can I download TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026 PDF?

Ans: Candidates can download the result PDF from the official website @tnpscresults.tn.gov.in

Q3. How can I check TNPSC Group 1 final Result?

Ans: Download the result PDF and search for roll number using the search option.

Q4. What details are mentioned in TNPSC Group 1 Result PDF?

Ans: The result PDF includes roll numbers, post name and qualifying status

Q5. What happens after TNPSC Group 1 Result 2026?

Ans: Selected candidates will complete appointment formalities before joining their allotted Group 1 posts.
